purpose: Add default-off IQ2_XS down-stream diagnostic support and verify synthetic plus real GGUF IQ2_XS ffn_down_exps row parity.
implementation_notes: IQ2_XS was added to lowbit_down_probe_candidate only behind GGML_MOE_STREAM_DOWN_LOWBIT_PROBE=1.
IQ2_XS was added to launch_moe_mmvq_compact_batch type gate for the diagnostic path.
The direct probe now gives each synthetic type a unique tensor name suffix to avoid cache-key reuse across different quant types in one process.

decision.meaning: The vendor down-stream entry can compute correct synthetic IQ2_XS and a real GGUF IQ2_XS ffn_down_exps row slice when explicitly enabled by the diagnostic env gate. Default production behavior remains unchanged.
limitations: Only a small real tensor slice was tested.
No full-model load/generation correctness was run.
No prompt-general token-rate, TTFT, or 16GB model-run gate was executed.
This does not cover IQ1_S/IQ1_M/Q2_K real GGUF bytes because no local full candidate with those exact tensors is currently available without disk cleanup/download.
decision.next_step: To move from parity evidence to performance, either enable an explicit candidate model run only after full load/correctness gates, or obtain/download a priority compact target with exact IQ1_S/IQ1_M/Q2_K real tensors.
